item.text:
Implemented trusted reverse proxy login in [server/app/auth.go](/app/server/app/auth.go:137). Navidrome checks the original connection IP against the configured whitelist, creates users on first trusted login, and includes session credentials in the frontend configuration only after successful authentication. The [frontend](/app/ui/src/authProvider.js:110) stores those credentials using the standard login fields. Nested map values are now redacted in [log/redactrus.go](/app/log/redactrus.go:58). Configuration and the optional default user are documented in the [README](/app/README.md:44).

Verification passed: relevant Go tests, all 35 UI tests, lint, formatting, and the production UI build. The build required Node’s legacy OpenSSL provider for this repository’s Webpack version.
